# Timetable pages lifted verbatim from "KP DJKA 116 TAHUN 2026 GAPEKA JAWA.pdf"
# (GAPEKA 2026), exactly as pdfplumber 0.11.4's extract_text() yields them and
# as data/gapeka/2026/pages.json caches them, except that trailing whitespace
# is stripped. Page numbers are 0-based, as the cache keys them. No test may
# open the 61 MB PDF; these lines are the timetables as far as the parser is
# concerned.
#
# tests/conftest.py groups these by the "# page N" markers and drops comments
# and blank lines. No timetable line starts with '#', so nothing is lost. A
# block that holds only part of its page says which part; the rest of the page
# belongs to a run this fixture does not carry.

# KA 1 Anggrek, Surabaya Pasarturi - Gambir: the first timetable of the
# intercity section, headed "Relasi". Pages 58 and 59 whole, and page 60 down
# to KA 1's last row. Almost every row is a timed pass ("Ls 08:21:00"): one
# time, where a stop prints two.
# page 58
